teksti: Choose the word that best completes the sentence:
If I ______ more free time, I would travel around South America.
ratkaisu: This is an imaginary situation in the present, so we use the second conditional.
Structure: if + past simple, would + base form → "If I had more free time, I would travel…"

teksti: Which word is closest in meaning to "reluctant"?
She was reluctant to share her plans with the rest of the team.
ratkaisu: Reluctant means not wanting to do something → unwilling.
Eager is the opposite: very keen to do something.

teksti: Write the past simple form of the verb in brackets:
The refugees ______ (seek) shelter in the neighbouring village.
ratkaisu: Similar pattern: buy – bought, think – thought, bring – brought.
